referenceRole: Original biome texture: style, color and scale reference

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square terrain texture for a fantasy globe game. Create ONE new variation of the attached reference; reference is for painterly style, scale, colors and material only, not an edit target. Preserve the same detailed hand-painted top-down/orthographic look and approximately the same brightness. Full bleed square, texture covers entire image edge-to-edge, no hexagon shape, no frame, no perspective horizon, no text, no icons, no buildings or creatures. Natural irregular arrangement with fine detail that remains legible as a small terrain tile. Match reference visual scale; do not create a landscape scene. Output a single 1024x1024 PNG texture.
Variation alpine-2: Broken slate-like gray rocks in a new irregular mosaic, pale lichen and only tiny sparse snow pockets.
